data.exact_reserve_text: Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 5.6m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2023 (2022 GBP 8.8m).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net reserve release of GBP 5.6 million for prior year reserves in 2023. This favorable development was primarily driven by the Property classes, although it was partially offset by adverse development in the Legal Indemnities class. Geopolitical events such as the ongoing war in Ukraine and recent conflict in the Middle East are noted as potential risks for higher-than-expected claims and financial market volatility.
raw_causal_phrases: adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class
recent escalation of conflict in the Middle East
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported as a net figure of reinsurance, as no gross figure was explicitly stated and the gross claims development triangle was deemed unreliable due to an RITC transfer in the prior year (2022).
